scope: New publication staging copy adapter, vendored helper, build call site and focused storage test. No article, capacity or final publication acceptance implied.
checks: Vendored cow_copy.py is byte-identical to the installed helper, SHA256 924b5ba7ddc50aada98810789d24f9340cbda40acd022369db20ef90716dc79e. Production code uses a repository-relative helper path, not a personal home path.

Read complete helper. macOS invokes native clonefile without --allow-full-copy or --no-hash. Clone failure aborts without silent full-copy fallback. Full source/output hashing, metadata verification, source-stability checks and independent inode checks remain enabled. Temporary staging is published atomically with no overwrite.

The adapter rejects an existing destination, including a symlink. The build keeps its existing disposable dist-publish rebuild behavior and its input/output symlink guards; frozen preparations and source assets are not targets.

Linux full copy is an explicit build call-site policy, not a failed-clone fallback. Before copying it rejects non-directory sources, symlinks and unsupported entries, measures total regular-file bytes and checks available space against bytes plus a 1 GiB reserve. It logs its explicit full-copy mode and preserves timestamps. Other platforms are refused by the actual build call site.

Actual independent focused test on this macOS host passed 1/1: one cloned file, zero full copies; exact file contents, distinct source/destination inodes, independent subsequent edit and existing-destination refusal.
No historical copy script or frozen evidence was rewritten to retrofit the storage policy.
limitations: Actual Linux branch execution remains pending required hosted CI; no Linux execution claim is made from the local macOS test.

Linux intentionally retains the existing independent full-copy delivery mode. Unlike the APFS helper it does not provide transactional tree publication, complete source-stability checks or ACL/xattr/creation-time verification. Do not describe the Linux path as having those macOS guarantees. Final hosted payload and source/package integrity checks remain required.

This focused test does not independently inspect physical shared blocks; native clonefile usage and its successful report were observed. The unchanged installed helper’s full race/link/metadata suite was not rerun.
No full build or final package was run by this reviewer. Source stability assumes the coordinator’s sequential build ownership.
